rationale: Boot timing footprint authenticated C0-to-C1 transfer and bounded-failure evidence
Governance must reject incomplete class feature Story control and boundary-test contracts
C0 boot failure must be bounded distinguishable and recoverable before C1 transfer
A harness that enforces assurance on everything else must itself be enforced, and a fixture nobody runs is an unverified fixture that looks verified
Task creation grants no authority and class never implies scheduling priority
Context switching must preserve complete isolation and class state with bounded cost
Priority inheritance cannot become capability or containment-class inheritance
WCET overruns and adaptive lower-class resource attacks must trip one bounded fail-safe transition
Dispatch latency class isolation priority orthogonality and queue exhaustion are coupled contracts
Pool allocation must be memory-safe bounded and prevent cross-class reuse at capacity
Capacity configuration governs whole-image memory class budgets and exhaustion behavior
Reclamation must reject stale handles wipe residual state and recover deterministically across classes
Firmware topology is hostile input and discovery cannot grant C2 device authority
Interrupt timer and device-service state must be isolated bounded and memory-safe
Bus discovery records device identity read-only and bounded without selecting drivers or granting DMA IRQ or MMIO authority
Executable parsing is a disposable C4 hostile boundary and never a C1 format parser
Mapping must create a fresh private C3 address space with W-X and explicit sharing only
Compatibility calls must mediate C3 authority provenance and buffers through one C1 policy path
Real executable handling must preserve C4 quarantine and fresh C3 launch under adaptive input
Spoor encoding is the bounded class-aware provenance atom for every adversary
Journal wrap and pressure cannot erase the newest critical cross-class evidence
Lock changes require low-overhead attributable events and never transfer class or capability
Overrun response must remain class-attributed and observable under adaptive load
Message IPC must be class-aware local capability-scoped bounded and non-authority-transferring
Shared pages require rights-sized revocable generation-safe cross-class grants
Grant must fail closed on every reachable defect including caller-chosen range overflow rather than panic on a kernel path
TXE packaging cannot promote C4 content and must preserve deterministic provenance for later C3 verification
Cycle-calibrated bounded measurement must observe RT paths without perturbing or exhausting them
Timing baselines and the regression gate must fail closed on missing malformed or regressed evidence
A second cycle source implementor must satisfy the shared trait contract on the host before any board exists
A timing gate must compare a quantity that is invariant to how fast the runner was, and must withhold a verdict on any metric whose measurement cannot support one
Fault capture and terminate-versus-resume policy must contain the faulting task and audit every decision
Double-fault IST handling must survive a compromised primary fault path and report before halting
Per-task CR3 installation must isolate address spaces with cross-space probes faulting and contained

W^X sealing and generation-safe teardown must hold adversarially in both directions before frame reuse and a real loaded workload must be contained and audited when it exceeds its granted capabilities

Import resolution must give every call site a decided target so a refused capability faults at a named address rather than an arbitrary one, and the system image itself must load and schedule a real task
Timer-driven preemption and priority inheritance must bound latency without granting priority from class
WCET overrun enforcement must fire declared policy within bounded ticks and audit every decision
Hostile saturation must degrade only the offender with RT reserves held and recovery bounded and complete
Decision-to-actuation latency must stay inside a scheduler-enforced bound with late actuation prevented
No plaintext survives teardown must be a measured invariant with a scanner proven able to fail rather than a property holding by accident of implementation
The decoded staging image must not outlive its own use and the wipe must be verified externally rather than asserted by the code that performed it
Entropy must be health-tested continuously and refuse rather than degrade and its determinism carve-out must be explicit and unavailable in a shipping image
Cryptographic primitives must pass published vectors refuse every tamper case allocate nothing and make nonce reuse impossible in the type system
A measured boot must release the sealed root and a one-byte-modified kernel image must not which is the only defence against an attacker building their own TinyOS
A fallback tier an attacker can force by disabling the TPM is a downgrade attack on the sealing defence so its key space must be disjoint and the policy per deployment
Process keys must derive from a hardware-sealed root with public metadata as binding salt only and be verifiably absent from a dump after use
At-rest ciphertext must bind to address and generation so a relocated or replayed block fails authentication into the fault path rather than yielding plaintext
Memory-encryption activation must be confirmed by read-back and an absent engine must be documented accepted risk rather than quietly assumed covered
Randomized base and process id must carry measured entropy as salt diversity only and must not cost the reproducible boots Tier 0 evidence rests on

The shipping image must actually preempt and enforce declared budgets rather than only describe mechanisms proven in fixtures, and its workload must carry an overrun declaration consistent with the containment stance the same system applies to a fault

A board that cannot say anything cannot be debugged, so the first output byte and the entry exception level must be established before any other AArch64 claim, with the absence of a hardware root of trust named rather than omitted
On a board with no isa-debug-exit a fault with no vector table is a silent hang with no output at all, so failure must become visible before the MMU or the timer is touched

With SCTLR_EL1.M clear every access is Device-nGnRnE, so a flat cacheable identity map is a prerequisite of measurement rather than a follow-on nicety, and only a before-and-after difference distinguishes it from a silently ignored write
A periodic tick must be verified by ratio rather than absolute value, and the counter that microbenchmarks read must be chosen against real registers rather than assumed from the architecture manual
Hardware evidence that no tool can reproduce is anecdote, so the image build serial capture and exit-code scheme must match the Tier 0 path a reader already trusts

The first non-Tier-0 numbers this project has ever had must arrive through an unchanged host parser, because that is the only remaining test of the arch-neutrality claim STORY-P1-01-03 made and could not check
A spine that records only an all-or-nothing state per Story cannot show that a gate closed, so real evidence stays invisible and the gates that need no hardware never get attempted

The zero assurance-verified Stories is attributed to LE-09 for nine Stories where the attribution is wrong, and D09 is the one candidate whose 25 gates are all tiered Host+T0, so whether that tier claim is true has to be checked gate by gate rather than assumed in either direction
Four correct decisions are recorded in prose with nothing enforcing them and the same shape has recurred five times in one week, so what is owed is the machine rather than a fifth prose correction

Nine consecutive sessions hand-synced the dashboard and the session that documented the cost watched two of its own figures go stale mid-edit, so the numbers are generated and the state claims are gated while the argument stays hand-written

The numerics that survived -08 drifted the very next day (the tabstrip said 3 decomposed under a tile saying 4), so the Overall-progress tiles are generated, the tabstrip bar footnote and Epic-denominator numbers are gated, and the Epic population is derived from disk; the selection mirrors -08 because the subject is the same two files

LE-65: STORY-P0-01-08 read Specified for four days after its own Report recorded Pass with every gate green because every gate compares sideways, so the spine now refuses a Specified header covered by a passing Report; In progress is deliberately not refused because REPORT-2026-07-30-01 proves a passing Report beside an In progress header is legitimate stated-debt state

Two subsystems wrote one priority field and whichever wrote last won silently, so an overrun could discard a boost a blocked waiter depended on and a lock release could discard the enforcement decision that demoted a task
The composed degrade-while-boosted scenario proved under real timer-driven preemption where the evidence is which task the dispatcher selected rather than what a priority field contained
The verb core is the single authorisation point so deny-by-default and audit must be demonstrated before any front-end exists
G-SEC-5 labels must be designed into the volume and shown to survive copy move and rename before three flavours of file verbs exist
The DOS front-end is a hostile-format parser and its totality and register-shape parity are the claim
The MS-DOS parity tests are TCB batch files under QEMU compared byte-wise against committed golden transcripts

The spoor gate: verb denials journaled as kernel spoors at the policy seam, asserted in-guest, corroborated by the TOS64-SPOOR/1 trailer as check-shell-parity third signal, and rendered by the SPOOR verb in the golden transcript (LE-56)

One coherent feedback epoch in and one atomic command commit out must be whole or nothing before any fieldbus exists so EtherCAT later conforms to a proven contract instead of the contract conforming to EtherCAT

A probe a workpiece sensor and a group thermal channel are not auxiliary axis feedback so ownership must be typed before controller integration or the Hexapod build looks complete while excluding the signal that closes the surface-following loop

A successful boot that looks identical to a dead board is unacceptable UX so the firmware framebuffer is asked for a splash after the verdict with every wait bounded and the descriptor treated as hostile input because the screen may never perturb the evidence
